title.value: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study
title.justification: The title directly reflects the content and focus of the paper, which is the evaluation of a decision aid for prenatal screening.
title.quote: Evaluation of a prenatal screening decision aid: A mixed methods pilot study

extractions.description: The paper discusses the development and evaluation of a decision aid designed to help pregnant women and their partners make informed decisions about prenatal screening for trisomy. It uses a mixed-methods approach to assess the decision aid's usefulness and acceptability in three prenatal care settings in Quebec City. The study finds that the decision aid is generally useful and acceptable, but suggests improvements in certain areas based on user feedback.
